resultText: - `out/product.png`: 1920×1080 RGB PNG rendered in Blender 5.2.2 with Cycles at 128 samples. It shows a simple stylized compact camera on a round pedestal, lit by three named area lights: "Key light", "Fill light" and "Rim light". The camera body uses one material, "Camera body", set to `#D94F30`. I looked at the render and it came out as intended, and the file checks out at 1920×1080. I didn't measure the rendered pixel colors, and the lighting makes the body look lighter or darker in places than the exact hex. The scene source is in `studio/`, and the `.blend` file and run receipt are under `studio/artifacts/.../studio_compact_camera_product_v3/`.
